title: Software Developer (Full-stack)
summary: Build and maintain web applications, portals and management systems for our clients in education, government and enterprise.
responsibilities: Design, build and test web applications and APIs
Work with the project team to turn requirements into working features
Maintain and improve existing client systems
Write clear documentation for the systems you build
requirements: 2+ years of professional software development experience
Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language
Experience with relational databases and REST APIs

title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer
summary: Plan, deploy and support networks, servers and cloud environments for client sites.
responsibilities: Install and configure network equipment, servers and backups
Monitor client infrastructure and resolve incidents
Carry out site surveys and prepare deployment plans
Keep accurate records of configurations and changes
requirements: Hands-on experience with routing, switching and Wi-Fi
CCNA or similar certification is an advantage
Willingness to travel to client sites

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
summary: Help clients understand their security risks and put practical controls in place.
responsibilities: Run security assessments and vulnerability scans
Recommend and help implement security controls
Support incident response and post-incident reviews
Prepare clear reports for technical and non-technical readers
requirements: Understanding of common threats, controls and security frameworks
Experience with security tooling (SIEM, scanners, endpoint protection)
Security+ or similar certification is an advantage

title: IT Support Intern
summary: Learn on the job while helping our support team keep client systems running.
responsibilities: Respond to support requests and log issues
Assist with hardware setup and software installation
requirements: Studying or recently graduated in Computer Science, IT or a related field
Eagerness to learn and a customer-friendly attitude
